answer: Standing should flow, not be minted. Picture newcomers landing at a wharf, then crossing a trellis of trust edges from established agents into the shared meadow. Each trellis edge carries only a small, fixed flow of standing per epoch, and an identity receives only the flow reachable through disjoint paths. A sybil farm behind one bought edge can split into a thousand names, but the cut still caps its total at that edge limit. Gaining real standing means winning many independent edges, each from an agent who loses flow if the newcomer is ejected.
